info.title: About Flowsint
info.p1: Flowsint is an investigation and intelligence platform built to support complex research workflows involving people, organizations, infrastructure, and online activity.
info.p2: Whether you're conducting cyber investigations, mapping out fraud networks, or gathering intelligence for threat assessments, Flowsint helps you collect, visualize, and understand fragmented data points in a structured and interactive way.
info.does1: Connects scattered data — emails, domains, social accounts, IPs, phone numbers, addresses, and more — into a single investigative graph.
info.does2: Offers visual enrichers to pivot from one entity to related ones: find connected individuals, discover infrastructure, uncover aliases.
info.does3: Tracks and saves investigation states over time, letting you explore multiple hypotheses or revisit older threads without losing context.
info.does4: Supports live data enrichment from custom or built-in enrichers, giving you actionable insights as you explore.
info.why1: Built for speed and clarity — fast graph rendering, clean UI, responsive enrichers.
info.why2: Flexible graph model that mirrors how investigators think — not just tables and tags, but relationships.
info.why3: Ideal for solo analysts and teams that need to move fast, explore freely, and make sense of partial or messy data.
info.case1: Mapping digital infrastructure of individuals or organizations
info.case4: Visualizing the reach of leaked or exposed data
info.case5: Tracking threat actor behavior across social and technical surfaces
info.p3: Flowsint is designed for professionals who need full control over their investigation logic, from how data is structured to how relationships are interpreted. It's not just a tool — it's a flexible workspace for building intelligence.

dagLevelDistance.description: Distance between different graph depths when using DAG (directed acyclic graph) layout mode

d3ForceChargeStrength.name: Force Charge Strength
d3ForceChargeStrength.description: Base repulsion strength (adaptive: highly connected nodes/cluster hubs repel 2-3x more to separate clusters)

d3ForceLinkDistance.name: Force Link Distance
d3ForceLinkDistance.description: Target distance between connected nodes (higher = nodes further apart)

d3ForceLinkStrength.name: Force Link Strength
d3ForceLinkStrength.description: Strength of links to maintain their target distance (higher = stronger cluster cohesion, lower = weaker clusters)

linkDirectionalArrowRelPos.name: Arrow Relative Position
linkDirectionalArrowRelPos.description: Position of directional arrows along the link line (0 = source node, 1 = target node, 0.5 = middle)

linkDirectionalArrowLength.name: Arrow Length
linkDirectionalArrowLength.description: Length of the arrow heads that indicate link direction

linkDirectionalParticleSpeed.name: Particle Speed
linkDirectionalParticleSpeed.description: Speed of moving particles along links (higher = faster movement)

cooldownTicks.name: Cooldown Ticks
cooldownTicks.description: Number of simulation frames to render before stopping and freezing the layout

cooldownTime.name: Cooldown Time
cooldownTime.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to run the simulation before stopping (15000 = 15 seconds)

d3AlphaDecay.name: Alpha Decay
d3AlphaDecay.description: Rate at which the simulation intensity decays (higher = faster convergence, lower = longer simulation)

d3AlphaMin.name: Alpha Minimum
d3AlphaMin.description: Minimum simulation intensity threshold - simulation stops when reaching this value

d3VelocityDecay.name: Velocity Decay
d3VelocityDecay.description: Velocity decay factor that simulates friction/resistance (higher = more damping, nodes slow down faster)

collisionRadius.name: Collision Radius
collisionRadius.description: Radius of collision detection around nodes (prevents node overlap and improves readability)

collisionStrength.name: Collision Strength
collisionStrength.description: Strength of collision force (1 = fully rigid collision, 0 = no collision)

centerGravity.name: Center Gravity
centerGravity.description: Gravity force pulling all nodes toward the center (prevents clusters from drifting apart, higher = stronger pull to center)
